source_gaps: The Apple restart page 116940 gives force restart steps for iPhone with Face ID, iPhone 7 and iPhone 6s and earlier only; no official fetched page gave steps for iPhone 8, iPhone SE (2nd generation) or other Home-button iPhones, so those are not planned. The Android page names no phone model or Android version for the force restart step. The iPad steps come from the Apple iPad guide, version 16.0.

source_refs.title: Restart an unresponsive iPhone - Apple Support
source_refs.section: Force your iPhone with Face ID to restart
source_refs.verified_excerpt: Press and hold the side button until you see the Apple logo (this might take longer than 10 seconds).
source_refs.model_visible_text: On iPhone with Face ID: Press and quickly release the 'volume up button'. Press and quickly release the 'volume down button'. Press and hold the 'side button' until you see the Apple logo. This might take longer than 10 seconds.
source_refs.extraction_method: WebFetch of the official page on 2026-11-17; the three steps are quoted from the named section with the button labels kept; the verified excerpt is an exact quote.

source_refs.title: Restart an unresponsive iPhone - Apple Support
source_refs.section: On your iPhone 7 or iPhone 7 Plus
source_refs.verified_excerpt: Press and hold both the side button and the volume down button at the same time
source_refs.model_visible_text: On iPhone 7 or iPhone 7 Plus: Press and hold both the 'side button' and the 'volume down button' at the same time until you see the Apple logo. This might take longer than 10 seconds.
source_refs.extraction_method: WebFetch of the official page on 2026-11-17 with a prompt asking for exact quotes; the step is exact apart from the bracketed label style and the verified excerpt is an exact quote.

source_refs.title: Restart an unresponsive iPhone - Apple Support
source_refs.verified_excerpt: Press and hold both the Home button and the side button or the top button
source_refs.model_visible_text: On iPhone 6s and earlier: Press and hold both the 'Home button' and the 'side button' or the 'top button' until you see the Apple logo. This takes around 10 seconds.
source_refs.extraction_method: WebFetch of the official page on 2026-11-17 with a prompt asking for exact quotes; the step is exact apart from the bracketed label style and the verified excerpt is an exact quote.

source_refs.title: Restart an unresponsive iPhone - Apple Support

source_refs.title: Force restart iPad - Apple Support
source_refs.section: Force restart iPad (models with Face ID or with Touch ID in the top button)
source_refs.applicability: iPad models with Face ID or Touch ID in the top button; the page applies this when iPad isn't responding and turning it off then on does not work
source_refs.verified_excerpt: Press and quickly release the volume button nearest to the top button.
source_refs.model_visible_text: On iPad with Face ID or Touch ID in the top button: If iPad isn't responding, and you can't restart it by turning it off then on, try forcing it to restart. Press and quickly release the volume button nearest to the top button. Press and quickly release the volume button farthest from the top button. Press and hold the top button. When the Apple logo appears, release the top button.
source_refs.extraction_method: WebFetch of the official page on 2026-11-17; the condition and steps are paraphrased from the named section; the verified excerpt is an exact quote.

source_refs.title: Force restart iPad - Apple Support
source_refs.section: Force restart iPad (models with the Home button)
source_refs.applicability: iPad models with the Home button; the page applies this when iPad isn't responding and turning it off then on does not work
source_refs.verified_excerpt: If iPad isn't responding, and you can't restart it by turning if off then on, try forcing it to restart.
source_refs.model_visible_text: On iPad with the Home button: If iPad isn't responding, and you can't restart it by turning it off then on, try forcing it to restart. Press and hold the top button and the Home button at the same time. When the Apple logo appears, release both buttons.
